ActiveSkills.Description: Launches unpredictable sparks that move randomly until they hit an enemy or expire.
ActiveSkills.WebsiteDescription: Lightning is a fickle servant. However, skilled casters have learned to harness this frenetic element to devastating effect. With a single incantation, two pulsing strands of electric energy appear, and begin to move erratically around the battlefield. Whenever one contacts an enemy, it discharges, dealing tremendous damage and frequently causing paralysis.

GemEffects.SupportText: Supports attack skills, or spell skills that deal damage.
